claim: My DIY smart-glasses project, powered by the Pi Zero! - Reddit
summary: This is the prototype for my smart-glasses project! Powered by the Pi Zero, it runs a basic user-interface on a small, transparent heads-up display using a small SSD1306 OLED display. Although the device looks a bit on the bulky side, it isn't too heavy to cause discomfort. This project has been in the works on-and-off as a side hobby (school had kept me very busy) for about 8-9 months now!
